title: Metro Cebu air quality remains ‘fair’ on Sept. 24

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Metro Cebu’s air quality remained in the “fair” category on Thursday, September 24, with the Environmental Management Bureau Region VII (EMB-7) recording an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 86 at 11 a.m. The reading comes as Metro Cebu’s air quality continues to improve from the “Acutely Unhealthy” levels recorded earlier this week, with the station registering “Fair” readings throughout the Wednesday afternoon and Thursday monitoring periods provided by EMB-7.
